summary: FUUSIC Fun AI Phase 2 — Talk on the Player: backend + web e2e PASS. 16/17 pytest green (the 1 failure is pure quota exhaustion — demo user hit max_sessions_per_day=20 during the test run; independently re-verified the same case with admin and all assertions hold). Independently re-verified the RadioProgrammingPolicyService matrix via POST /api/fun-ai/radio/action: (D) play_exact_song → allowed:false code=ON_DEMAND_NOT_PERMITTED with alternative+alternative_action; (C) energy_change value=high_energy on managed → allowed:true code=CHANGE_OK applied={energy:'high_energy'} station_type=managed; (E1) third_party + format_change → allowed:false code=THIRD_PARTY_SEQUENCE_LOCKED alternative_action=change_station; (E2) third_party + change_station → allowed:true code=STATION_SWITCH_OK target=big-melodies; record_feedback → FEEDBACK_OK with applied.feedback; unknown action on managed → ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED; unauthenticated action → 401; action=skip fresh user → allowed exactly 6 times then SKIP_LIMIT_REACHED (matches default policy skip_per_hour=6). Managed changes return allowed:true with applied payload for mood/language/energy/format (prefs persistence contract verified via endpoint contract — direct DB inspection not available from the preview). GET /api/fun-ai/radio/formats returns groups {energy, mood, genre, language} with expected values. GET /api/fun-ai/radio/now-playing?station=big-melodies returns station_type=managed and resolves station_name from db.channels; unknown slug falls back to the name query param. POST /api/fun-ai/session {surface:'player', station:{...}} returns surface='player', tools=[get_now_playing,get_available_radio_formats,request_radio_action,record_music_feedback], instructions mention 'policy engine' authority and (for third_party) 'third-party' + 'switch stations' guidance; default POST /api/fun-ai/session {} returns surface='news' tools=[search_news, follow_story] with no player tools. Permanent xAI key never leaks (substring 'xai-3rsOv' absent from /session response). Admin GET/PUT /api/admin/fun-ai/radio-policy round-trip verified: non-admin (demo@) gets 403; admin GET returns merged policy+formats; PUT patch skip_per_hour=9 persists and the next GET reflects it (restored to original in teardown). Web /now-playing?ch=big-melodies: rl-talk-funai-btn mounts talk-funai-panel; the Stop button copy reads 'Stop & resume radio' (confirms surface=player wiring) and the panel header shows the station context ('FUUSIC Radio'). Grok WS 'ready' state could not be re-verified via browser in this run because demo@ hit the 20/day session cap during pytest — the ephemeral client_secret + ws_url contract is verified at the API level (test_session_player_surface passed).
critical_code_review_comments: services/fun_ai_radio_policy.evaluate() is the single authority — the model is never trusted. Deterministic, exception-safe (deny() path returns a structured decision; no raises on denial). The on-demand check runs BEFORE the per-station allowed_actions check so a listener on a third-party station asking for an exact song still gets ON_DEMAND_NOT_PERMITTED (the correct, less confusing code) rather than THIRD_PARTY_SEQUENCE_LOCKED — good UX.

resolve_station_type() has sensible fallbacks: body.type wins → channels (managed) → imported_radio_stations (managed if it has a flagship_slug, else third_party) → default managed. A missing slug/id maps to managed, which is the safe-default (richer action set).

DEFAULT_POLICY.managed_allowed_actions whitelists exact action names (format_change/mood_change/energy_change/language_change/station_preference/change_station/skip/record_feedback). Any unknown verb (e.g. 'teleport') falls through to ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED on managed — tested.

_skips_last_hour() counts only allowed:true skip docs in the last hour, so a denied-skip (over the limit) does not itself extend the window. Fresh user got exactly 6 allowed then the 7th denied — matches policy.skip_per_hour=6.

routes/fun_ai.radio_action persists prefs ONLY when decision.allowed AND decision.applied is non-empty (sets = {f'prefs.{k}': v for k,v in applied.items() if v}). This correctly ignores an empty value='' (e.g. energy_change with no value) rather than wiping the field — nice.

services/fun_ai_service.player_tools_spec() exposes 4 tools (get_now_playing, get_available_radio_formats, request_radio_action, record_music_feedback). request_radio_action's enum includes 'play_exact_song' so the model can SURFACE the request to the policy engine (which will deny it) rather than silently refusing — matches the design intent that Fun AI is NOT the authority.

player_anchor_instructions() correctly branches on station_type to add the third-party line ('live third-party broadcast whose song sequence cannot be changed — you can only switch stations'). Verified in test_session_player_third_party_instructions (via admin to bypass demo quota).
Admin PUT /radio-policy filters to known keys via DEFAULT_POLICY whitelist in set_policy() — unknown fields in the body are silently dropped, so no arbitrary doc shape can be injected. Good.

Minor: /api/fun-ai/radio/action logs every attempt to fun_ai_radio_actions with {user_id, action, allowed, code, station_type, at} — gives full audit for compliance review. Would be useful to also store params.value and station.slug for an easier retroactive 'what did Fun AI route this user to' audit; not blocking.

Minor: now-playing resolves station_type by probing db.channels and db.imported_radio_stations on every call. For hot paths this is 2 queries per call; a tiny in-memory TTL cache (10–30s) keyed by slug would eliminate it. Low priority — current latency is acceptable.

Minor UX: when action is 'change_station' with no target in params, allow() still returns STATION_SWITCH_OK with target=None. Consider denying with a 'target_required' code so the model doesn't send the listener nowhere; today the model's prompt should supply a target but a defensive check would be safer.

success_rate.backend: 100% (all 11 Phase-2 acceptance criteria pass; the lone pytest failure is quota exhaustion on demo@, not a product defect — verified separately with admin)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (rl-talk-funai-btn → talk-funai-panel → surface=player confirmed by 'Stop & resume radio' copy and station header)

Admin PUT to /radio-policy was reverted to the original skip_per_hour value in test teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 Talk on the Player is production-ready. Authoritative regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter229_fun_ai_radio_policy.py (17 tests, 16 should PASS on a cold run; test_session_player_third_party_instructions can quota-fail if the demo@ fun_ai_sessions count for the day is already high — if you see 429 session_limit there, re-run with a fresh account or bump max_sessions_per_day for the day). Prior regressions: /app/backend/tests/test_iter227_fun_ai.py (Phase 1 — 11 tests) and /app/backend/tests/test_iter228_fun_ai_modes_follows.py (Phase 2 modes+follows — 17 tests). Testids added for Now Playing player voice: rl-talk-funai-btn, talk-funai-panel, talk-funai-status, talk-funai-mic, talk-funai-stop. Policy engine is at services/fun_ai_radio_policy.py — DO NOT confuse with the older services/radio_policy.py (that one gates station visibility, a different concern). Default policy: on_demand_allowed=false, skip_per_hour=6, managed_allowed_actions=[format_change,mood_change,energy_change,language_change,station_preference,change_station,skip,record_feedback], third_party_allowed_actions=[change_station,record_feedback]. Admin can tune via PUT /api/admin/fun-ai/radio-policy with the DEFAULT_POLICY whitelist. Real voice-triggered tool calls can only be verified end-to-end in a real-mic environment; the /radio/action endpoint matrix + /session player tools+instructions are the agreed proxy and are both verified.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. The lone pytest failure (test_session_player_third_party_instructions returned 429 session_limit) is an operational artifact: the test suite opens 2 real Grok sessions for demo@ before this test, plus demo@ already had sessions-today from earlier main-agent testing. Reproduce: run the file twice in <24h with the same demo account. Mitigation: use a fresh account OR raise max_sessions_per_day in services/fun_ai_service for the test tenant OR add a daily session reset admin hook. The third-party player instructions themselves are verified correct (contain 'third-party' + 'switch stations') via a direct admin-session call during this run.
